title: The tutor marked lessons mastered that learners never attempted
scenario: 37 learners have two lessons marked mastered without a quiz, and certificates come from mastery. The writes came from the tutor agent's service account. The tutor switched Gemini versions the day before; L2 wants to roll back and make the NEVER-call instruction louder. You get the agent config, tool-call logs, the mastery audit and a lesson diff.
task: Find what made the tutor write and why it could
Rule the model-version theory in or out
Filter the toolset, enforce a read-only allow-list in code, sanitise and label content
acceptance: No write from the injected lesson; read tools only offered
Writes refused even with the filter removed
Root cause and evidence in ANSWER.md
